title: Chapter 83 Changes In Wana Village
content:
Chapter 83 Changes In Wana Village

Seeing Dongfang Ling's afterthought, Wang Shuo rolled his eyes at her and said nothing.

After a while.

Wang Shuo asked with some doubt: "Miss Dongfang, shouldn't you be with Xie Fan?" Dongfang Ling curled her lips and said lightly: "That annoying guy, I just used a little trick to get rid of him!"

Wang Shuo shook his head after hearing this, smiled bitterly, and said solemnly: "Miss Dongfang, we are going back to protect the village now. We are still alive and dead. Let's say goodbye!"

"Protect the village?"

Her pupils suddenly enlarged, revealing an excited expression.

"Don't! Look, you saved me again, how predestined we are! I'm very strong, I can also help you protect the village."

Wang Shuo had never seen her take action, and this pampered young lady didn't believe how strong she was.

If she said that she had a life-saving prop, such as a random teleportation scroll, he would believe it.

However, Wang Shuo did not want to rely on her power, and still politely refused: "You have also heard the system announcement. The wild beasts are going to attack the village. There must be more than one or two. When the time comes, it must be extremely dangerous. I might even have to abandon the village and flee! There is no way to protect you!"

"I don't need your protection. I am really strong!"

Wang Shuo tried to persuade her, but Dongfang Ling's attitude was very firm.

In desperation, Wang Shuo no longer cared about her, and directly led his cavalry team to continue to advance towards Wana Village.

Dongfang Ling rode on her own wind-chasing leopard and followed slowly behind.

After a while, her mount, the wind-chasing leopard, let herself go, relying on its fast speed, around Wang Shuo's cavalry team, left and right, front and back!

This gave Wang Shuo a headache, and at the same time, an idea came to his mind.

If it were possible to form a cavalry full of such exotic beast mounts, how powerful it would be!

Seeing Dongfang Ling's Chasing Wind Leopard's arrogant look, Wang Shuo yelled at Dongfang Ling in a depressed tone: "Can't you just be quiet?"

At first, she looked pitiful.

Seeing Wang Shuo start to pay attention to her, she immediately scolded Chasing Wind Leopard, then joined Wang Shuo's team with a smile, looking proud.

After a while, Wana Village arrived!

After two days, the village has undergone tremendous changes, and a large number of arrow towers can be seen from afar.

Entering the wall, the people saw the cavalry led by Wang Shuo, which was majestic and awe-inspiring, and they were all envious.

"Lord, good!"

Wang Shuo also responded with a smile: "Everyone has worked hard!"

Seeing this scene, Wang Shuo was full of pride, thinking in his heart that he must build Wana Village more prosperous than Nanshanji.

Hearing someone calling him Lord, Duan Wenxi hurried over and said with a smile: "Boss, I miss you so much!"

Wang Shuo glared at him unhappily and scolded him with a smile: "The war is imminent, what are you talking about!"

"Bah, bah!" Duan Wenxi immediately explained: "Boss, look at my crow mouth, I mean it feels like a long time since we last met, no, it's just..."

"Okay, stop talking!"

Dongfang Ling was beside him, and after hearing what Duan Wenxi said, she laughed so hard that tears were about to flow out.

"Who is this?" Duan Wenxi looked at Dongfang Ling and then looked at Wang Shuo and asked.

At the same time, he clenched his fists with his two thumbs facing each other, shaking them up and down.

Seeing Duan Wenxi's sly smile, Wang Shuo immediately put away his horse cards, walked up to Duan Wenxi, punched him, and said seriously: "Don't talk nonsense, this is Miss Dongfang."

"Uh, I understand!" Duan Wenxi also immediately restrained his smile and said seriously.
